@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_parallel_usage_overlapping_ticket_validity(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    order = Order.objects.create(event=event, status=Order.STATUS_PAID, customer=customer,
                                 expires=now() + timedelta(days=3), total=23,
                                 sales_channel=event.organizer.sales_channels.get(identifier="web"))
    OrderPosition.objects.create(order=order, item=requiring_ticket, price=23, used_membership=membership,
                                 valid_from=datetime(2021, 4, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=TZ),
                                 valid_until=datetime(2021, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=TZ))

    overlapping = OrderPosition(item=requiring_ticket, price=23, used_membership=membership,
                                valid_from=datetime(2021, 4, 5, 0, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=TZ),
                                valid_until=datetime(2021, 4, 15, 0, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=TZ))
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        _validate(customer, [overlapping], event)
    assert 'overlaps with this time frame' in str(excinfo.value.message)

    not_overlapping = OrderPosition(item=requiring_ticket, price=23, used_membership=membership,
                                    valid_from=datetime(2021, 4, 11, 0, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=TZ),
                                    valid_until=datetime(2021, 4, 15, 0, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=TZ))
    _validate(customer, [not_overlapping], event)

    requiring_ticket.validity_dynamic_start_choice = True
    requiring_ticket.save()
    membership.date_start = now() - timedelta(days=1)
    membership.date_end = now() + timedelta(days=30)
    membership.save()
    cp = CartPosition(event=event, item=requiring_ticket, price=23, used_membership=membership)
    _validate(customer, [cp], event, valid_from_not_chosen=True)

    membership.date_end = now() - timedelta(days=1)
    membership.save()
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        _validate(customer, [cp], event, valid_from_not_chosen=True)
    assert 'but selected a ticket that starts to be valid on' in str(excinfo.value.message)
